text:
sophia: FYI Nimbus Distributors opened a dispute. They say the Feb invoice billed the Dedicated upgrade for the full month even though upgrade was effective 2026-02-15 and they expect proration or apply commit credits.
dan: can you paste the invoice lines?
sophia: here:
```
INV-2026-5172
2026-02-01 - 2026-02-28 Dedicated Base (5 GPUs): $9,500
2026-02-15 Upgrade to Dedicated Plus: +$7,200
Credits applied: $0
```
hamid: checked the SOWupgrade effective 2/15, proration is required unless a waived admin note exists. We should calculate the prorated amount for days in Feb after upgrade.
maria: quick calc: extra charge $7,200 * 13/28 = $3,342.86. Looks like we overbilled ~$3.3k for Feb.
dan: accounting ops suggestion: issue CN for $3,342.86 and post adjusting journal for Feb close: DR Sales Rev $3,342.86 / CR Deferred Rev $3,342.86 (treat excess as deferral until service period ends). Also record a short-lived accrual to AP if CN not yet applied at close.
hamid: approved. Manager sign-off confirmed.
billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-7799 and credit note CN-2026-512 for $3,342.86.
sophia: thanks. Maria  please add a one-line note in the month-end close deck with calculation and link to BILL-7799. Also tag audit.
maria: done  added slide under "Revenue adjustments" and attached CN PDF. Ops to post JE before EOD close.
billing-bot: CN placed in AR queue. :white_check_mark:
